Comment.Language: For the Feast of the Pentecost:

Text.Language: AP,#c# pennou]: twnf e~bol qen n/eymwout: ouoh afsenaf e~p~swi e~niv/oui~: afouwrp nan m~piparakl/ton.
Christ our God, has risen from the dead, He ascended to heaven, and sent the Comforter.
المسيح إلهنا قام من بين الأموات وصعد إلى السماء وأرسل لنا المعزى.
<ere tefanalum'ic: e~tafsenaf e~p~swi e~niv/oui~: afouwrp nan m~piparakl/ton: Pip#n#a# n~te ]meym/i.
Hail to His Ascension, when He ascended to heaven, He sent the Comforter, the Spirit of Truth.
السلام لصعوده لما صعد إلى السماء وأرسل لنا المعزى روح الحق.
Pip#n#a# m~parakl/ton: e~tafi~ e~pec/t e~bol qen t~ve: afvwrs e~jen v~ouai v~ouai: aucaji qen hanm/s n~lac.
The Spirit of Comfort, which came down from heaven, laid on each one of them, and they spoke in many tongues.
الروح المعزى لما نزل من السماء انبسط على كل واحد فواحد فنطقوا بألسنة كثيرة.
